title: Prototype an earned automation opening and a dedicated sniper Sentry
context: Owner wants a satisfying sniper tower and suggests replacing Howitzer with Needle or Railgun. Owner proposes a slow opening with only Isao and Tank, manual turret operation inspired by Sniper Lab, Isao constructing the Terraformer/Stalheart, and chip production subsequently enabling turret automation. This extends the prior build-capacity ideation without selecting its final rules.
outcome: Retain two connected playability experiments after architecture/parity: compare Needle and Railgun for a deliberate, readable sniper shot; evaluate manual weapons before site establishment and chip-enabled automation so powerful autonomous towers feel earned. Keep operator aiming/input separate from target acquisition commands while sharing firing eligibility, cooldown, projectile and damage rules. Decide later whether chips are a one-time unlock, per-turret component or production constraint. No roster, early-game tutorial, build prerequisites, factories, economy or progression was changed. Current history records retiring Needle/Railgun in the numbered-roster migration; no current entry found for this chip-factory opening. The upstream viewer currently lists Needle, Railgun and Howitzer, but their assets were not downloaded into gameplay.
alternatives: Replace Howitzer with Needle after a side-by-side manual-fire prototype.
Replace Howitzer with Railgun after a side-by-side manual-fire prototype.
Test manual-to-automatic progression separately from prepared sites and power capacity before combining constraints.
evidence: https://jelaludo.github.io/SentryTowers_A6/sentries/ retrieved 2026-09-08; family selector includes Needle, Railgun and Howitzer.
